issue.title: Align Spark model completion description casing
issue.description: Discovered in an unrelated full-suite verification run. tests/test_xprompt_model_completion.py::test_model_completion_catalog_reflects_real_builtin_model_metadata fails reproducibly in isolation: the current catalog description is 'codex (gpt53spark)' while the test expects 'Codex (gpt53spark)'. Decide the intended provider display casing and align the registry/catalog implementation and assertion.
